name: Rocket Propulsion
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, covering topics such as propulsion theory, engine types, fuel chemistry, and the practical applications of rocket technology.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of aerodynamics, focusing on the principles and applications of airflow and its effects on flying objects.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: This course delves into the principles and practices of spacecraft design, offering students a comprehensive understanding of the engineering and technology behind spacecraft systems.

name: Orbital Mechanics
description: This course provides a comprehensive study of orbital mechanics, focusing on the motion of spacecraft in orbit around celestial bodies.

name: Space Mission Design
description: This course explores the process of designing space missions from concept to execution.

name: Rocket Engines
description: This course examines the design and operation of rocket engines, including propulsion systems and fuel types.

name: Space Exploration
description: This course covers the history and future of space exploration, including missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
